decision.name: Credentials gained without a legitimate kernel transition
decision.reasoning: exploit post-condition (T1068): credentials gained with no commit_creds during the call (a write into the task's struct cred, or its pointer replaced) — caught at capable() (lite), call ioctl (16), mechanisms none; before [uid=1000 euid=1000 suid=1000 fsuid=1000 gid=1000 egid=1000 cap_eff=0x0 cap_prm=0x0 userns=4026531837] → after [uid=0 euid=0 suid=0 fsuid=0 gid=0 egid=0 cap_eff=0x1ffffffffff cap_prm=0x1ffffffffff userns=4026531837]; the same struct cred, written in place; detect mode: recorded, not stopped; posture → ENGAGED (COMBAT with corroboration)
decision.response: recorded only (exploit guard lite, detect, caught at capable()): the task continues

decision.name: Namespaces or root left without a legitimate kernel transition
decision.reasoning: exploit post-condition (T1611): namespaces replaced with no switch_task_namespaces — caught at switch_task_namespaces (lite), call setns (308), mechanisms none; before [uid=1000 euid=1000 suid=1000 fsuid=1000 gid=1000 egid=1000 cap_eff=0x0 cap_prm=0x0 userns=4026531837] → after [uid=1000 euid=1000 suid=1000 fsuid=1000 gid=1000 egid=1000 cap_eff=0x0 cap_prm=0x0 userns=4026531837]; namespaces mnt 4026531841→4026532300 pid 4026531836→4026531836 net 4026531840→4026531840; SIGKILL sent in kernel before the return to user mode; posture → ENGAGED (COMBAT with corroboration)
decision.response: killed in kernel (SIGKILL from switch_task_namespaces, before the return to user mode; exploit guard lite, enforce)
